environment: WSL2 Ubuntu 24.04 x86_64, 16 logical CPU, Rust 1.100 release (opt3, thin LTO), system FFmpeg 6.1.1 for the FFmpeg engine; audit with PyAV 16.1 (FFmpeg 8) and ffmpeg 6.1.1
input: 13 fcamera.hevc + 13 qcamera.ts original-format corpus on NTFS via drvfs (read only); outputs on WSL ext4

engines.ffmpeg: default-feature release `remux` CLI (native inspect worker + FFmpeg muxing + output inspect + box check)
engines.pure: `pure-remux` release `__pure-remux` (single streaming read with input hash + pure Rust output read-back unless --no-verify)

comparison_note: a pilot run before the framing fix found TS sample size differences in 1124/1200 packets of segment 1 (trailing zero padding); not part of these numbers

benchmark.order: rotated and alternately reversed per round
benchmark.rss: 20ms sampled process tree sum; pure runs are 30-250 ms long so mean RSS is undersampled (median 6.5 samples)

workload.ffmpeg_validated: input inspection/hash (TS: separate native inspect process; HEVC: hash inside mux worker), mux, output inspect process, timestamp and box checks
workload.pure_validated: input hash inside the mux pass, mux, pure Rust read-back of output with signature/timestamp/layout checks
workload.ffmpeg_core: HEVC: __native-hevc (mux + input hash, no output check); TS: ffmpeg CLI stream copy (no hash, no check)
workload.pure_core: mux + input hash, no output read-back

benchmark.outliers: segment 3 HEVC round 3: ffmpeg_core 8.51 s wall / 0.58 s CPU and ffmpeg_validated 6.18 s / 0.70 s; I/O stall, excluded only by the median

limiter_diagnostic_single_runs_segment3_.note: 3 sequential repeats with /usr/bin/time, not benchmark samples

browser.engine: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) HeadlessChrome/157.0.0.0 Safari/537.36 Edg/157.0.0.0
browser.mode: headless=new, fresh temp profile, loopback 127.0.0.1:18161 with Range
browser.retry_segment5_ts: first metadata wait timed out (15 s); two reruns with FFmpeg output alongside: both loadedmetadata, seeks seeked, readyState 3-4, no error
